Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No ketones or significant proteinuria detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
